resources.string: Controller layout while a controller is connected, touch layout without one.
Always the touch layout: rail, lists and sheets.
Always the controller layout: big menus, button hints and the Start menu.
Essential: what changes the picture and the speed (%1$d).
Advanced: also compatibility, input and system (%1$d).
All: every setting the core reads, debugging included (%1$d).
For every game; each game can change them on its own sheet
Away from the default in every game
No game changes a setting of its own.
For the whole app, not for the games.
The language and country the games see are in Console and system
Games with a value of their own; the global one does not hold for them.
Saves and data of the profiles
Each profile in its own folder
On: each game sheet can look up the settings other players shared for it.
Off in this build: no server is set.

With a server, each sheet looks up by Title ID the settings others shared, the most similar phone first, with “helped” and “did not help” votes. Applying goes through the same preview as the presets and can be undone.
Sharing sends only the phone model, the build and the settings of the game: no account, gamertag, file name or path.
Saved sessions; share one or all, with personal data removed
A/B with one change only (driver, limit, frame generation)
Look at what the sources offer to see the driver suggested by the Adreno family in the file names.
None: every game uses the driver above.
Changing applies the next time a game starts. Installed binaries stay, so going back never downloads again.
Every download is checked: an arm64 Vulkan library, and the SHA-256 when the release publishes one.
Flags handed to the Turnip driver (TU_DEBUG) when the next game starts. Proprietary drivers ignore them. They hold for every game; a game can have its own on its sheet.
Flags this version does not describe are kept: %1$s
Its files leave the phone. Download or import it again to use it later.
Draws straight to memory instead of in the on-chip tiles (GMEM). Slower, but avoids a class of Adreno GPU hangs. XenDroid default.
Always draws in the on-chip tiles. Faster where it works; the opposite of sysmem.
Turns off LRZ, the early depth test. Can fix flickering or missing geometry; costs speed.
Turns off only the fast clear of LRZ. A narrower version of nolrz.
Turns off UBWC image compression. Can fix corrupted textures or render targets; more memory traffic.
Turns off the multi-position output optimization. Can fix stretched or flickering polygons.
Does not resolve tiles while the next ones draw. Can fix artifacts on Adreno 7xx; slower.
Does not load tiles while others draw. Can fix artifacts on Adreno 7xx; slower.
Always uses the binning pass in tiled rendering. For diagnosis.
Flushes the GPU after every command. Very slow; narrows down which draw hangs the GPU.
Waits for every draw to finish. Very slow; for diagnosing GPU hangs.
